### Cause of Bug
When copying an [`XmlMapper`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_b_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/XmlMapper.java#L101-L105), its underlying [`XmlSerializerProvider`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_b_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/ser/XmlSerializerProvider.java#L55-L60) shared the existing [`XmlRootNameLookup`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_b_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/util/XmlRootNameLookup.java) instance from the source provider. Because `XmlRootNameLookup` caches resolved root names without taking configuration into account, root name resolutions performed by the original mapper polluted the lookup cache used by the copied mapper (and vice versa).

### Fix
In [`XmlSerializerProvider.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_b_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/ser/XmlSerializerProvider.java#L59), instantiated a new [`XmlRootNameLookup`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_b_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/util/XmlRootNameLookup.java) instance during copy construction rather than reusing the source provider's instance.

### Verification
- Ran the original failing test [`MapperCopyTest.testCopyWith`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_b_fix/src/test/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/MapperCopyTest.java#L74-L91) and verified it passes.
- Generated the focused patch file [nl_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
